notes.title: The definitive version with new languages is finally here!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

It's been quite a while since the last update, but we can finally present Murder on the Marine Express in its final version.

This update contains all the changes introduced for the recent release of the game in consoles, since now it's also available for Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One and Xbox Series X|S. In addition to minor improvements in the graphic section, the main novelty is the inclusion of new languages (French and Japanese) and a professionally edited version of the English texts, which fixes the errors that still persisted.

We hope you can enjoy the game on the platform of your choice and that you continue to support us in our next projects, of which we hope to offer some news in the near future.

Thank you!

notes.title: Steam Autumn Sale and big update incoming
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

It's been a while since our last report. We've been working very hard polishing the novel and we have already reached the last stages of production. What does this mean? Well, in addition to fixing the last bugs present, we made a deep revision of the script in Spanish and English... and we have also included new languages such as French and Japanese!

These new features will arrive in a new update that will be available soon, not only in its PC and mobile version, but also for consoles. Yes, that's right. Murder on the Marine Express will be available on consoles very soon. We hope that you will be able to enjoy our story wherever you want, although you will still have to wait a little longer to know the release date.

In the meantime, for all of you who haven't yet read Ranko Togawa's first adventure, we prepared a 15% discount for this Autumn sale period, so don't miss the chance to get your hands on the game ahead of these upcoming update.

Thank you very much for your kind support.

notes.title: Version 1.04 is up!
notes.notes:
Hello again, Ranko fans!

Coming back with a new update dedicated to fixing a big chunk of the grammar and spelling errors present in the English script. Even so, we are aware that the text is still far from perfect, so expect to see some professional editing in the near future. In addition, we also took this chance to adjust one of the game's transitions at the end of the story.

We keep working on polishing the novel to the best of our abilities and hope to bring good news about localization to more languages soon.

Thank you so much for your kind support and your patience!

notes.title: Version 1.03 Up!
notes.notes:
Hello again, Ranko fans!

We've received new reports about the previous issue related to the flash effect, that now causes crashes even when turned off, so as a precaution we have decided to eliminate them completely, at least until we can find a definitive solution to the problem.

Also, we've fixed some more typos, mainly on the english text (we're not native, sorry.).

Again, thank you for your patience in our first foray!

notes.title: Version 1.02 Up!
notes.notes:
Hello again, Ranko fans!

Sorry for the inconvenience, but due to a gaffe on the previous patch, 3 whole sentences of chapter 1 disappeared from the english version of the game! This is fixed now on version 1.02.

Also, some more typos have been corrected!

Thank you for your patience!

notes.title: Version 1.01 Up!
notes.notes:
Hi all Ranko fans!

We just uploaded version 1.01 of the game with the following fixes:


 Fixed an issue where you could access other menus from the Chapter Selection menu
 Fixed an issue that produced rare crashes due to the Flash VFX
 Fixed some typos


Unfortunately, we were not able to test if the Flash VFX crash is 100% solved, so if anyone encounters the bug again, please report it in the bug thread and keep the Flash VFX OFF while we work to resolve it.

Thank you for your patience!
